name: Revolutionary
description: A regular, non-animated paint that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on November 22nd, 2024.
The paint was sold in the game from November 22nd to December 20th, 2024 in a special offer "Fan’s bundle" in honor of the «Winter Major 2024» tournament.
